description: Which other entities are likely under common control with this one, and who did it take over from or hand over to? Returns affiliates with relation_type (shared trade name, shared mailing address, similar name in the same city), confidence and the evidence that matched; plus took_over_from and taken_over_by: businesses that followed one another at the same premises under the same or a similar trade name (a sale or a reorganisation, not common control), each handover dated. Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Inferred links, not ownership records. Example: {"entity_id": "32057926266"}.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.

min_confidence.description: Only affiliates at or above this confidence, 0.5-1. Default 0.5.

name: find_affiliates
title: Related Texas businesses
